definitionEn: your mother and father
example: My parents both work full-time.

definitionEn: a female parent
example: Her mother picks her up from school.

definitionEn: a male parent
example: His father cooks dinner on Fridays.

definitionEn: a woman married to your father but not your mother
example: His stepmother is kind and funny.

definitionEn: a man married to your mother but not your father
example: She lives with her mum and stepfather.

definitionEn: a brother or sister

definitionEn: a brother who is older than you
example: My elder brother is already at secondary school.

definitionEn: a sister who is younger than you
example: I walk my younger sister to school.

definitionEn: a sister born at the same time as you
example: Her twin sister is in a different class.

definitionEn: the parents of your mother or father
example: We visit our grandparents every Sunday.

definitionEn: the mother of your mother or father

definitionEn: the father of your mother or father

definitionEn: the child of your son or daughter

definitionEn: the sister of your parent, or your uncle's wife

definitionEn: the brother of your parent, or your aunt's husband

definitionEn: the man a woman is married to

definitionEn: the woman a man is married to

definitionEn: not married

definitionEn: having promised to get married

definitionEn: a holiday just after a wedding

definitionEn: a person with no brothers or sisters

definitionEn: parents and their children living together

definitionEn: a mother or father bringing up a child without a partner

definitionEn: to become the legal parent of a child who is not born to you

definitionEn: to leave your bed in the morning
